novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanism and measurement hypothesis: it proposes that “suppositional and categorical belief states are encoded along partially separable, causally-manipulable directions” and that counterfactual errors reflect “leakage” between those registers. Searches using “LLM hypothetical supposition internal representation,” “counterfactual context parametric knowledge activation steering,” “context knowledge conflict linear probe,” and “belief bias reasoning activation steering” identified the closest prior work as Mitigating Content Effects on Reasoning in Language Models through Fine-Grained Activation Steering (AAAI 2025), which already treats plausible prior content as contaminating formal reasoning and causally reduces that bias through activation steering, alongside established context-versus-parametric-knowledge conflict studies. Moving from those results to paired categorical-versus-suppositional representations is a natural but substantive extension: the same broad conflict-and-steering template remains, yet defining two item-specific belief registers and hypothesizing that their geometric collapse predicts frame leakage changes the unit of analysis and adds a relationship not supplied directly by the closest work.
